required_parts: blue jacket with charcoal yoke and shoulders
black skis with teal edges and upturned tips
relations: T-pose with a slight downward arm slope matching the reference
poles hang from the hands to just above the ground
boots stand in the bindings on the skis
goggles sit under the helmet brim
model faces -Y in Blender, origin on the ground between the skis

surface_targets: fitted torso, limbs, boots, and gloves rather than a block mannequin
albedo, roughness, metallic, and normal maps

limits.axes: Blender Z up, face -Y; glTF export Y up for Three.js

review_questions: Does the front view match the reference yoke, jacket, poles, and skis?
Do the side and three-quarter views read as a clothed skier rather than boxes?
Does the fresh glTF import keep scale, materials, and Y-up orientation?
